scope: All repository source, documentation, hidden GitHub templates and build scripts; the secret scan also covers the 1.0.2-r1 package content (the install tree produced by the same materialize step as the APK; 106 files). limitations: Automated scans are combined with template/default review and screenshot inspection; they are not a mathematical proof of the absence of all possible sensitive data.
